T1.texte: things to do at 11pm instead of scrolling

en: telling everyone your goals can give you a hit of
dopamine before you've actually done anything
T2.fr: annoncer tes objectifs te file [[un shot de dopamine]] avant d'avoir fait quoi que ce soit
T2.texte: not a whole chapter, not a goal to hit. just 10 pages of something you actually want to read

T3.fr: t'as [[le kif de l'ambition]], les compliments, tu vois déjà le résultat [[sans avoir bossé]]
T3.texte: paper doesn't light up or autoplay the next thing, so [[your eyes get heavy on their own]]

en: stop talking about what you're going to do. disappear,
put your head down, and let your results speak for you
T4.fr: arrête de parler de ce que tu vas faire. disparais, bosse en silence et [[laisse tes résultats parler]]
T4.texte: most nights i stop at 10. some nights i look up and it's been [[40 pages and an hour]] without my phone

T1b.fr: ton [[cortex préfrontal]] gère l'organisation, le focus et la volonté
T1b.texte: half of what keeps you awake is your brain [[repeating a to-do list]]

T2.fr: [[gâche pas]] ta tête fraîche pour des mails et des bricoles
T2.texte: put it on paper and [[it stops looping]] in your head all night

T3.fr: passe [[les 60-90 premières minutes]] sur ce que t'aurais envie d'esquiver
T3.texte: only 3, the ones that matter. tomorrow you wake up and [[already know where to start]]

T1.texte: stretch on the floor for [[10 minutes]]

T2.texte: no workout, no plan, just your body:

T3.fr: des livres costauds, des discussions difficiles, des compétences nouvelles, des problèmes à résoudre [[sans chercher direct la réponse]]
T3.texte: hips, lower back, neck, the shoulders that spent all day hunched over a screen. slow, with [[the lights low]]

T1.fr: lis des livres [[au lieu de scroller]]

my apps until i read for 20
